description: This file defines an AppRouter class in Dart that centralizes and handles all named routes for a Flutter application, including static and dynamic routes for folder and document screens. It includes route parsing, matching logic, and placeholder widget screens.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: Contains static methods for route generation and helpers for route matching and ID extraction.

classes.name: _LockScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget representing the lock/authentication screen.

classes.name: _HomeScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget representing the home folder overview screen.

classes.name: _FolderScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for displaying a folder given its ID.

classes.name: _DocumentScreen
classes.description: Placeholder widget for displaying a document given its ID.

classes.name: _ErrorScreen
classes.description: Widget displayed when routing encounters an error such as invalid IDs.

methods.name: onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Main route generator function that returns a Route based on the RouteSettings, handling static and dynamic routes.

methods.name: _tryMatchWithId
methods.description: Helper function to match paths like '/folder/123' and extract the ID segment.

methods.name: _extractId
methods.description: Helper function to parse and extract an integer ID from either the path segment or the route arguments.

methods.name: _error
methods.description: Helper method to generate an error route with a message.
